Site: Mass General Brigham Incorporated 
 
 Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.
 
 
 Job Summary 
The Opportunity

Full Time M-F This position will serve on our Digital Patient Experience team and will be a key member of our CRM Platform Management team focused on Salesforce HealthCloud solutions.

The Software Engineer is vital to the team and will implement, maintain, and support technical platforms comprising software, networks, hardware, and databases. Responsible for the implementation and support of technical solutions, including platform systems that require critical aspects of infrastructure, network, application, database, and security frameworks.

-Manage day-to-day operations of enterprise platforms, including applications, servers, storage, and networked services.
-Monitor and optimize platform performance, availability, and capacity. 
-Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform issues across multiple environments. 
-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools to improve operational efficiency. 
-Contribute to the design and implementation of new platforms and services. 
-Participate in platform upgrades, migrations, and patch management. 
-Support security hardening and vulnerability remediation efforts. 
-Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business and technical projects. 
 
 
 Qualifications 







 
 Bachelor's Degree Computer Science required
 Bachelor's Degree Related Field of Study required
 MGB can consider and review, experience in lieu of a degree for this role
 Experience as a systems engineer or related position 3-5 years required
 
Skills for Success
 Proficient in administering enterprise systems and platforms.
 Strong understanding of networking concepts, firewalls, and load balancers.
 Strong understanding of data structure and database systems.
 Intermediate scripting and automation skills to streamline operational tasks.
 Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and hybrid environments.
 Ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex system and application issues.
 Experience with system monitoring tools and interpreting performance data.
 Understanding of system security concepts and the implementation of security-leading practices.
 Effective collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical teams.
 Salesforce Developer Certifications Preferred: Platform Developer 1, Platform Developer 2, Javascript Certified Developer
 Salesforce Administrator Certifications Preferred: Administrator 201, Administrator 301 preferred.
 Experience with Object Oriented Programming Languages: Java experience required
 Experience with .NET Core, C#, React, MVC, HTML/JavaScript/Ajax, and XML preferred.
 Experience with the Lightning Framework and the creation of Lightning Web Components
 Experience with responsive UI design utilizing frameworks like Bootstrap preferred.
 Experience with Relational Database design and development using MS SQL Server.
 Experience developing Integration Web Services with RESTful and SOAP protocols.
 Experience with APIs, Integration principles (ideally including Epic).
 Proficiency with developing reports is desired.
 Experience with Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, Team Foundation Server, Azure Dev Ops, and SharePoint is desired.
 Experience with Agile, Scrum or CMMI software development methodologies is desired.
 
 
 Additional Job Details (if applicable)

 M-F Eastern Business Hours

 Remote workdays require stable, secure, quiet, compliant workspace

At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package. 
 
 EEO Statement:

 Mass General Brigham Competency Framework 
 At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.
